gumroad_rich_content_root_cause.exact_cause: the product's rich_content contains a fileEmbed node whose attrs.id is 3gOnjSXQ_kgRtjfzg0oh-A==, which is the file named eu_ai_act_compliance_toolkit - the 31-page PDF containing the compliance guarantee. Gumroad refuses to detach any file still referenced by an embed.
gumroad_rich_content_root_cause.why_cycle_86_concluded_it_was_unfixable: cycle 86 searched only the `description` field for the file id, found none, and wrongly concluded the embed was unreachable. The embed lives in a separate top-level `rich_content` field that was never inspected.
gumroad_rich_content_root_cause.the_instruction_we_missed: the full API error reads: 'Cannot remove files still referenced in rich content: ... Remove the file embeds from rich content first, OR SEND BOTH CHANGES TOGETHER.' The API explicitly permits a combined request.
gumroad_rich_content_root_cause.the_real_blocker: rich_content is writable ONLY through a JSON request body. Sending it as form-encoded data always fails with 'rich_content must be an array of content page objects', regardless of payload shape - which is what made it look read-only.
gumroad_rich_content_root_cause.payload_shape_required: {'rich_content': [ {page object} ], 'files': [ {'id': existing_id}, {'url': newly_uploaded_url} ] } sent as a JSON body
